胁，因他们世界的奇异博士曾滥用黑暗神书引发入侵而被处决。旺达附身地球-838的自己追踪而至，以压倒性力量屠杀光照会全员。奇异博士在地球-838克里斯汀帮助下直面自己内心的懦弱，为保护阿美莉卡不得不同样使用黑暗神书梦游附身主宇宙尸体，与旺达决战。关键时刻阿美莉卡觉醒能力，将旺达传送到孩子面前，孩子恐惧的眼神让旺达幡然醒悟，她摧毁所有黑暗神书源头万达格山，自己随之消失。战斗结束，阿美莉卡留在卡玛泰姬，奇异博士向克里斯汀坦诚告别，学会接受遗憾。回到主宇宙后，奇异博士因使用黑暗神书额头上长出第三只眼。片尾彩蛋中神秘女子克莉出现，警告他因干涉多元宇宙引发新入侵，要求他前往黑暗维度解决危机，奇异博士跟随她踏入新冒险。"}]}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"d2f17698-b1c8-44ba-a8da-eb445a4dcac6","nodeId":"9622c3ebc3ad42a9b126c285da787139"}}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6e6713c6-1424-44fc-9df4-f9eebe6f91f2","nodeId":"5819e5be923341be9f267e4dfd03fe41"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#00BA73"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"豁免"}]},{"type":"ordered_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"665081b3-51d6-4f27-a4fc-bb26bb9fe9bd","start":1,"nodeId":"4166cb6627dd4e798a84d33a7963cfc2"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-6e430167-7902-4587-a49d-a0f8a5c90da2","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"58ce9f06611b45fda9a349fe72ee1575"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"119ab7c1-3061-4694-9bab-1b83080fad42","nodeId":"345daacc158e4078a379970f5579cf3e"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}}],"text":"展示无大纪元画面的多影片混剪内容时"}]}]}]}]},{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[327],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"","bgColor":"","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"57525ad0-d97a-4c1a-bfab-c7e6d42c122b","nodeId":"99e76843151c4c49a3ab95b3fa9b7183"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"87180e4a-337a-4638-b13e-e449dd21a0bf","nodeId":"4bd14e2a4dfb4a2eacea4906c26f798e"}}]},{"type":"table_cell","attrs":{"colspan":1,"rowspan":1,"colwidth":[489],"textAlign":"","verticalAlign":"","bgColor":"","color":"","numCell":false,"dataCellDiffId":"303350f8-6 7437f0a-5b64-4df6-8672-680de01d21df","fontSize":15,"value":null,"nodeId":"00adb8f621d547b09884b697ceb74ed1"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"96fdcf4e-8a0a-44bc-ad4b-157c86cb3a06","nodeId":"6c96e4dad00c428b8b8252431c900d05"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"十三世达赖喇嘛"}]}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"fc841949-e12b-48b0-960d-a0d2b59eb1af","nodeId":"d401227b809b472f95949a84236e0e53"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"管控原则："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3cb0abcb-25d8-43bb-8f51-d6bb66404cf9","nodeId":"76169484da2146a5aeeedf8abc0710e4"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络安全法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"fa122690-b17d-411e-87c5-ac81b0b06b83","nodeId":"05b7b6b1b0b8404ba9acc4a9353d5c53"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"第十二条　国家保护公民、法人和其他组织依法使用网络的权利，促进网络接入普及，提升网络服务水平，为社会提供安全、便利的网络服务，保障网络信息依法有序自由流动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"0c5e0819-5131-4457-b96e-bb3aa9daf68a","nodeId":"fdad4f3510c5482e827254220d12bb42"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"任何个人和组织使用网络应当遵守宪法法律，遵守公共秩序，尊重社会公德，不得危害网络安全，不得利用网络从事危害国家安全、荣誉和利益，煽动颠覆国家政权、推翻社会主义制度，煽动分裂国家、破坏国家统一，宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义，宣扬民族仇恨、民族歧视，传播暴力、淫秽色情信息，编造、传播虚假信息扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序，以及侵害他人名誉、隐私、知识产权和其他合法权益等活动。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"e9938d15-8685-4bfe-8f7f-c89090047aba","nodeId":"64709ce1b3cb4886917b408f7bf9a6b5"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"网络信息内容生态治理规定"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"218a6e34-6e8a-4bb9-a688-31171a52a04d","nodeId":"de9602376f404aa28f4a7e3a905cda1b"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第六条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者不得制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的违法信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"01f2245b-46fd-4e8e-a6a8-73e1efd3a066","nodeId":"b4130b1ea979408497437c88132d8164"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）反对宪法所确定的基本原则的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3b95175c-32ca-424d-828e-59b966dd03c7","nodeId":"c99140b1eaa947a689d526168a4fc304"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（二）危害国家安全，泄露国家秘密，颠覆国家政权，破坏国家统一的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6c71d23a-44e8-4f88-be09-aadbae01f0bf","nodeId":"3f9b4fab0cab4710b5b111f7631d0b05"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（三）损害国家荣誉和利益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"79ee15f1-8cba-4a1c-8df6-a2c900c0d7b6","nodeId":"6eea1adcd48d442886814795e1feac33"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）歪曲、丑化、亵渎、否定英雄烈士事迹和精神，以侮辱、诽谤或者其他方式侵害英雄烈士的姓名、肖像、名誉、荣誉的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"3b904739-9e0e-4c45-b8a3-c7b12c40a0cb","nodeId":"d862b6066fcb4fb08403d9c98cb39940"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）宣扬恐怖主义、极端主义或者煽动实施恐怖活动、极端主义活动的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4e54fa09-446a-4ec0-b8c2-50559eef3bf9","nodeId":"4d281b2141d54a0090e11fc90e92a3e8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）煽动民族仇恨、民族歧视，破坏民族团结的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"1c2bda56-f1cb-4b88-9bde-a1ce32f43e10","nodeId":"08a4818a7a3b4beda6a90e764ceaae31"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）破坏国家宗教政策，宣扬邪教和封建迷信的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"de9d84f1-edf0-46e1-be5d-3830fb8f768d","nodeId":"6d5c53bdbac74f80b958f55ce4998da7"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）散布谣言，扰乱经济秩序和社会秩序的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"58ef7e64-3a33-4c34-bf4f-6bd6109649e2","nodeId":"c856ae001ba6435db32dac70296cd538"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）散布淫秽、色情、赌博、暴力、凶杀、恐怖或者教唆犯罪的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"01f453ef-e28a-40c9-9247-cc8d2cbbf9d0","nodeId":"ba96b5bf93d14641a19248262e7b75cd"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十）侮辱或者诽谤他人，侵害他人名誉、隐私和其他合法权益的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"41807841-03b7-4c8a-9410-5803417ece55","nodeId":"a8181a69b4ec4aaeb6c75a5472bedc24"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十一）法律、行政法规禁止的其他内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4963e2fb-e7bb-4f78-936e-96db7112cf4f","nodeId":"7acfa8fdd2aa48ecbbf394f092f8d9a1"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"第七条"},{"type":"text","text":"　网络信息内容生产者应当采取措施，防范和抵制制作、复制、发布含有下列内容的不良信息："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"94377358-4c3d-483c-a558-52f3618c3989","nodeId":"4ff065155c274a4f9baa5ea4a23bad9c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）使用夸张标题，内容与标题严重不符的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"8f346780-1347-4d66-9fda-38d632c80753","nodeId":"efc927033e0d4bd7b64831af2098d17c"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）炒作绯闻、丑闻、劣迹等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"b9c824a1-caf7-41fe-a3a3-f9f8e866e0f4","nodeId":"525637f99552408b96cb63376164fcd5"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）不当评述自然灾害、重大事故等灾难的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"8cb464e3-1597-4ae3-a230-7f345a54c487","nodeId":"adfb270a3dd7458ab2c5a307b71d937b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（四）带有性暗示、性挑逗等易使人产生性联想的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"eca6985c-d51b-41b1-8280-7755d6fc1ef3","nodeId":"d1b676dbfbac42ca95ddbc35f72e4213"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）展现血腥、惊悚、残忍等致人身心不适的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"a632d684-ebea-4bea-a147-a85c874b1a53","nodeId":"58aecbca0e6746cda199093c32355e8f"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）煽动人群歧视、地域歧视等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"8be0f8bc-86f2-4953-a85a-d6951a8e8c57","nodeId":"8a2928dcce0a4344a7f4742aa4d3d61d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）宣扬低俗、庸俗、媚俗内容的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"2fee934b-545f-4222-b573-43acdbc2ca00","nodeId":"515f1e64e119493e8739f76df08eedd5"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）可能引发未成年人模仿不安全行为和违反社会公德行为、诱导未成年人不良嗜好等的；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4d5cad17-3ffc-4f4e-9c9e-f08fd58ee762","nodeId":"304b44332f784ca8a8f1aa09e992e820"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）其他对网络生态造成不良影响的内容。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"431de6fd-4784-4891-9432-079bcd798931","nodeId":"2eec9ea3118c4a988fddfe6af44a39ec"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"广告法"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6257b347-70e9-4938-a946-dfa940ace1ee","nodeId":"f5ced1b05e9644f7a300c4b47b6b1de1"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"广告不得有下列情形："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"7ebe488a-36a6-4cc6-b8cc-89a73baa1626","nodeId":"d3dd973873b5462294e951756e170fc8"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（一）使用或者变相使用中华人民共和国的国旗、国歌、国徽，军旗、军歌、军徽；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"933236c5-cc34-4b59-936d-e9da8c69eb98","nodeId":"84eeed697e154f849155f7d13e0f04e6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（二）使用或者变相使用国家机关、国家机关工作人员的名义或者形象；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"bedaf856-5566-49e4-94d4-24e1f5185b84","nodeId":"e2e5b678a1154d22913b8de0c26a1115"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（三）使用“国家级”、“最高级”、“最佳”等用语；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"f709f636-ade8-4848-9aa6-f649ff597161","nodeId":"16c8ca3153fd47bab8a4292c88657d1b"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"underline"}],"text":"（四）损害国家的尊严或者利益，泄露国家秘密；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"6fa15fe9-b863-4f74-998a-86900867b4f8","nodeId":"1c77cbbaa72d4684b3381a7c3d682029"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（五）妨碍社会安定，损害社会公共利益；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"e91d4b15-d9ae-49c3-9ceb-2583dca23649","nodeId":"7ecb4de849094111b49782e917e2a015"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（六）危害人身、财产安全，泄露个人隐私；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"5aa3e112-6c39-4df4-b112-6d0b2b6e451f","nodeId":"57849be74c48438d9217274de5619950"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（七）妨碍社会公共秩序或者违背社会良好风尚；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"5d1d72a7-90c2-4c45-9d0c-8f104d96bc5e","nodeId":"39b1cfad2f034c298dc3a59602f6c809"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（八）含有淫秽、色情、赌博、迷信、恐怖、暴力的内容；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"5c563cef-a104-474c-8fe3-3b73609f8381","nodeId":"74a4ada8d9d14240842174cb63d8d41d"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（九）含有民族、种族、宗教、性别歧视的内容；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"725a2e90-adf1-4923-b562-1c084c963273","nodeId":"5cbef7d72cea4cdcb2a7fd98308c036b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十）妨碍环境、自然资源或者文化遗产保护；"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"start","dataDiffId":"047d0df4-e2d1-490f-acf6-50ee0cbdb8a3","nodeId":"e01711e38c9144e3a7ac52805b384db6"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"（十一）法律、行政法规规定禁止的其他情形。"}]},{"type":"footnote_list","attrs":{"nodeId":"632b59b9b4b049df90e9f5993f928e44"},"content":[{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"b9ecea99ad964b0496822806015d706a","footnoteNodeId":"f707ff677a3746209a9567b8e8490bf0"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"2179d8000a134177bebea0907ba173a2"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"香港七一游行：香港民间人权阵线等社会运动组织发起的反动游行活动，于2003年-2021年每年的7月1日举行。"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"6c67fe1158454604821ec3f2a357de1d","footnoteNodeId":"a1f0022062af4937803a3996fd6cc20d"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"cd830ebba5d4460d9734c13522d9a11b"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"中性语境说明：表明该表述不带政治主张，在生活旅游场景下对于机构、地名的客观描述。"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"5eaa77277aaa4e5ab82bd706fd35d8bc","footnoteNodeId":"f4a979d952834607b7402cccc9df1e8d"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"1021b3f01e4f439aa396ff0de10c2d96"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"自治区：内蒙古自治区、广西壮族自治区、西藏自治区、宁夏回族自治区、新疆维吾尔自治区"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"517f81ab96404a5d9eb43a6c749ffd36","footnoteNodeId":"0b09aa634fd1428686d1f5f1ad9fb6c2"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"a8ea413e82974388ad339d758c140fa4"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"尖阁X岛：尖阁列岛、尖阁群岛、尖阁诸岛"}]}]},{"type":"footnote_list_item","attrs":{"nodeId":"a303f5c09ba64ad9a71f6baf9a21c98c","footnoteNodeId":"4077b264fff14d749c001e8679a8b970"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"left","dataDiffId":null,"nodeId":"14360354d3c0404790442c9c855cde2a"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"藏族身份保护周：伪“西藏流亡政府”发布声明，将每年9月第4周设立为“藏族身份保护周”，以对抗民族团结进步宣传周；"}]}]}]}]}
